title: Richards Embedded Mass-Conservative Temporal Estimator Feasibility and Reference Construction

current_decision.reason: The embedded estimator must first be reconstructed at equation, state, startup, variable-step, mass and bounded-cost level and mapped to SWAP's existing semi-discrete Richards owner boundary.

open_gate_A_items: obtain and reconstruct the exact Kavetski-Binning-Sloan discrete temporal formulas
map required primary and auxiliary states to SWAP pressure-head/water-content ownership
determine whether the method needs one solve, embedded correction solves, or multistep history per accepted interval
separate persistent history from worker scratch
prove or explicitly test ledger mass conservation under candidate advance
define a test-only MMS verification case
define the later independent held-out physical-envelope qualification boundary
next_action: Reconstruct the primary candidate algorithm from original literature and audit the current SWAP HeadCalc/semi-discrete state interface against its required variables and operations. Persist a Gate A mapping before writing any estimator prototype.
